intended_use: Proactive credit line and APR management for active credit card accounts

performance_metrics.notes: Populated by train_portfolio_action_model.py at training time

fairness_assessment.notes: Fair lending analysis must be completed before Production promotion (SR 11-7)

guardrail_rules: DPD60+ (delinquency_status >= 2) → CLD or HOLD only; CLI and APR_DOWN blocked
Charged-off account → HOLD only; no other action permitted
Bureau score < 560 → CLI and APR_DOWN blocked
industry_worsening scenario: CLI blocked if utilisation_12m_avg > 70% or bureau_score_3m_change < -30
recession scenario: CLI and APR_DOWN both blocked portfolio-wide
base scenario override: full-payer (full_pay_months_12m >= 11) + spend growth > 10% → APR_DOWN for retention
CNPV gate: any CLI with scenario_weighted CNPV delta < 0 reverted to HOLD

regulatory_compliance.tila_reg_z: APR_UP actions require 45-day advance change-in-terms notice
regulatory_compliance.ecoa_reg_b: CLD and APR_UP actions must queue adverse action notice with >= 2 reason codes within 30 days
regulatory_compliance.scra: Active military accounts: APR increases blocked; CLD only with notification flag
regulatory_compliance.usury: APR_UP cannot push account APR above applicable state usury cap
regulatory_compliance.disparate_impact: CLD disparate impact ratio (protected/control) must be >= 0.80 before batch execution
regulatory_compliance.policy_versioning: policy_version used for each batch must be recorded and resolve to an approved_by entry

limitations: Trained on synthetic data; annual recalibration on live portfolio mandatory post-production
HOLD is dominant class (>90% of accounts); class_weight=balanced required to prevent HOLD bias
Feature engineering requires 12 months of statement history; new accounts (<12 months) should default to HOLD
Scenario probabilities (base 55%, worsening 30%, recession 15%) are static — should reflect macro outlook at review time
